en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph depicting a large building in a park-like setting, viewed through tall, leafless trees. The structure has a pitched roof, gables, and arched windows, designed in a traditional German architectural style. There are small groups of people visible in the foreground, suggesting it is a place of gathering or leisure. The top of the postcard contains printed German text in a decorative, serif typeface.
